description: Training-set residual contrasts after the core Gradient Boosting model.
milk_bonus_status: Experimental academic demo assumptions: rarely +1.0, sometimes +1.5, every day +2.5 nmol/L. Not scientifically validated; fortification and serving size vary.
cap_method: Binary deductions are positive magnitudes, limited to 2.0 nmol/L individually and 4.0 nmol/L combined. The provisional UI values below are 1.0, 0.5, 1.5, 1.0, 0.5 and 1.0 nmol/L, then the combined cap is applied.
cap_status: Experimental academic UI heuristics; not medically validated thresholds.
residual_method: Five-fold out-of-fold residuals from core Gradient Boosting, random_state 42. Negative estimates are shrunk by max(0, abs(raw contrast) - standard error); non-negative observed associations receive zero binary penalty.

kidney.applied_method: Fixed provisional YES deduction; not the raw NHANES contrast.
kidney.shrinkage_rule: negative effect beyond one standard error; otherwise zero
kidney.reason: Observed held-out association was non-negative; no negative binary penalty applied.
